source: …And that’s the progress of the project so far, Mr. Clermont.  I believe we’ve reached all targets on schedule.
translation: ……以上就是项目目前的进展，Clermont先生。我认为我们已经按时完成了所有目标。

source: That’s great to hear! I’m glad to know everything’s still on track!
translation: 听到这个真好！很高兴知道一切仍在按计划进行！

source: If you need any more details, you can find them in the report we’ve provided.
translation: 如果您需要更多细节，可以在我们提供的报告中查阅。

source: Excellent. But before we conclude this meeting, I have other concerns that I would like to discuss with everyone.
translation: 很好。不过在结束会议前，我还有一些问题想和大家讨论。

source: What is it, Mr. Clermont?
translation: 是什么事，Clermont先生？

source: Well, throughout the previous months I received separate reports from our inspector.
translation: 这个嘛，过去几个月里，我分别收到了检查员提交的报告。

source: I know that we’ve achieved our preliminary goals, but based on Ms. Komarova’s account, it seems that there were difficulties encountered along the way.
translation: 我知道我们已经实现初步目标，但根据Komarova女士的描述，过程中似乎遇到了一些困难。

source: I’m sorry, I don’t think we were informed about this…
translation: 抱歉，我想我们没有收到关于这件事的通知……

source: Then this is the perfect moment to discuss these matters and ensure that we can move forward with the project positively.
translation: 那么现在正是讨论这些问题、确保项目能积极推进的最佳时机。

source: Ms. Komarova, if you may.
translation: Komarova女士，请吧。

source: Thank you for bringing this up, Mr. Clermont. I believe these matters are of utmost importance.
translation: 谢谢您提出这件事，Clermont先生。我认为这些问题至关重要。

source: As the standing representative for quality assurance, I wanted to discuss some specific departmental concerns that need to be corrected.
translation: 作为常驻质量保证代表，我想讨论一些需要纠正的具体部门问题。

source: Ugh… here we go again…
translation: 呃……又来了……

source: Y-Yuri…!
translation: 尤、Yuri……！

source: Let’s start off with Mr. Choi. I’ve found his reversed sleep schedule to be very unprofessional.
translation: 先从Choi先生开始。我认为他颠倒的作息非常不专业。

source: He sleeps the whole day starting from 9:00 am until 6:00 pm which are the peak productivity hours. There was no way for me to reach him in-person to oversee his work.
translation: 他从早上九点一直睡到下午六点，正好覆盖效率最高的工作时段。我根本无法当面找到他监督工作。

source: A-Ah… I admit that was very unprofessional of me… I apologize for causing trouble.
translation: 啊、啊……我承认这确实很不专业……很抱歉给大家添麻烦。

source: If I may – I, too, was honestly concerned about this in the beginning, but despite Jin’s schedule being different from us, he had no problems communicating with the rest of the team.
translation: 容我说明——一开始我也确实担心这件事，但尽管 Jin 的作息和我们不同，他与团队其他人的沟通没有任何问题。

source: More importantly, he completed all his deadlines with time to spare. I would know, because I also watched over the progress of his department.
translation: 更重要的是，他总能提前完成期限内的任务。我很清楚，因为我也监督了他所在部门的进度。

source: Even so, it would’ve been optimal if he were accessible in the same time frame as everyone else. Not to mention that it’s a potential health concern.
translation: 即便如此，如果他能在和其他人相同的时段联系到，依然最为理想。更不用说这还可能带来健康问题。

source: I-If it helps… I’ll promise to change my habits from now on…!
translation: 如、如果有帮助……我保证从现在起改变习惯……！

source: Moving on to the construction department, I have noticed inconsistencies with the time cards of Mr. Sirius and Mr. Najjar.
translation: 接下来是施工部门。我注意到Sirius先生和Najjar先生的考勤卡存在不一致。

source: From my observations, it was mostly due to the unnecessarily extensive morning routines they partake in.
translation: 据我观察，主要原因是他们每天早晨进行的例行活动过于冗长，而且毫无必要。

source: W-What does that have to do with anything…?
translation: 这、这和工作有什么关系……？

source: She’s nitpicking at this point.
translation: 她现在纯粹是在挑刺。

source: At the end of the day, it doesn’t matter. Some of us may have different schedules and routines, but we all adjusted to each other and finished the work according to all the deadlines.
translation: 归根结底，这无关紧要。我们有些人的日程和习惯或许不同，但大家都互相适应，并在所有期限内完成了工作。

source: We don’t snoop around and call you out for your personal schedules!
translation: 我们可不会四处窥探，再因为你的私人日程点名批评你！

source: Which brings me to another issue: Ms. Nomoru’s attitude problem. She’s very hostile towards me, as you can see.
translation: 这就引出了另一个问题：Nomoru女士的态度。正如各位所见，她对我非常敌视。

source: Attitude problem?! Why I—
translation: 态度问题？！我——

source: Yuri, calm down.
translation: Yuri，冷静。

source: And last but not least, I have a strange issue with Mr. Flynn. According to my investigations, he was still exhibiting indecent behavior around camp.
translation: 最后同样重要的是，Flynn先生有个奇怪的问题。根据我的调查，他仍在营地里做出不得体的行为。

source: Even though I pointed it out at the beginning, it seems that he refused to listen to initial warnings and there were still instances of such displays.
translation: 尽管一开始我就指出了这一点，他似乎拒绝听从最初警告，之后仍出现过类似表现。

source: Hmm? This wasn’t included in your reports. Please elaborate.
translation: 嗯？报告中没有提到这件事。请详细说明。

source: It’s nothing serious, Mr. Clermont. She’s talking about the times where we needed to wear less clothing to cool off from the work. You know how men are.
translation: 不是什么严重问题，Clermont先生。她说的是我们工作太热、需要少穿点衣服降温的时候。您知道男人就是这样。

source: With the weather getting colder, surely a habit like that is unnecessary. I just thought it was important to point out.
translation: 天气已经越来越冷，这种习惯显然没有必要。我只是认为有必要指出。

source: Although, I have to give props where they’re due. If it weren’t for Mr. Nagira being in charge of overseeing Mr. Flynn’s department, things could’ve been worse.
translation: 不过，该肯定的地方还是要肯定。如果不是Nagira先生负责监督Flynn先生的部门，情况可能会更糟。

source: Not to mention, if one of the staff is handling JUST the maintenance, wouldn’t it make more sense that the scoutmaster title for Mr. Flynn be revoked and changed back to a ‘helper’?
translation: 更不用说，如果一名员工只负责维护工作，撤销Flynn先生的教官称号、让他重新成为“帮工”不是更合理吗？

source: Not to mention, if one of the staff is handling JUST the maintenance, wouldn’t it make more sense that the scoutmaster title for Mr. Flynn be revoked and changed back to a ‘helper’?{fast}
translation: 更不用说，如果一名员工只负责维护工作，撤销Flynn先生的教官称号、让他重新成为“帮工”不是更合理吗？{fast}

source: Just maintenance?
translation: 只是维护工作？

source: Just… maintenance?
translation: 只是……维护工作？

source: Excuse me, but maintenance is not an easy job at all.
translation: 恕我直言，维护工作一点也不轻松。

source: You don't know what you're saying.
translation: 你根本不知道自己在说什么。

source: You don’t know what you’re talking about.
translation: 你根本不知道自己在说什么。

source: You don’t see how hard he works to keep the camp running.
translation: 你没有看到他为了维持营地运转有多么努力。

source: Aiden does more than you think.
translation: Aiden做的远比你以为的更多。

source: Aiden does a lot more than you think.
translation: Aiden做的事情远比你以为的更多。

source: He’s really stepped up to the scoutmaster role these last few months, and that’s not even counting all the other work he does that you don’t even see.
translation: 过去几个月里，他真正承担起了教官的职责，这甚至还没算上那些你根本看不到的其他工作。

source: This camp wouldn't even function without Aiden.
translation: 没有Aiden，这座营地甚至无法运转。

source: What are you talking about? This camp wouldn’t function without Aiden.
translation: 你在说什么？没有Aiden，这座营地根本无法运转。

source: You don’t have any right to question his role considering how much he does for Camp Buddy, especially these last few months.
translation: 考虑到他为伙伴营付出了多少，尤其是过去几个月，你没有任何资格质疑他的职务。

source: Aiden had to wake up the earliest to prepare meals and other essential needs for more than thirty people. Including yourself.
translation: Aiden必须最早起床，为三十多人准备餐点和其他必需品。也包括你。

source: He also took care of the sanitation of facilities and occasional repairs on top of that, which he always handled without fail.
translation: 除此之外，他还负责设施清洁和偶发维修，而且每次都处理得毫无差错。

source: Now imagine that during a summer term with all the scouts too. And he still manages to participate in physical and wellness activities at the same time.
translation: 再想象一下夏季营期所有童子军都在时的情况。而他同时仍能参与体能和健康活动。

source: I request that you’d be more empathetic to everyone here as your co-workers.
translation: 我希望你能对这里的每一位同事多一些同理心。

source: I’m only telling things as they are. I can’t let an opportunity to point out legitimate flaws pass.
translation: 我只是在如实陈述。不能放过任何指出真实缺陷的机会。

source: I just think that everything you’ve brought up so far hasn’t been relevant to the project but are rather personal issues you have with us.
translation: 我只是认为，你目前提出的一切都与项目无关，更像是你对我们的个人意见。

source: You can’t expect me to stand by and not defend everyone, especially if you’re being unreasonable.
translation: 尤其在你如此不讲道理时，不能指望我站在一旁、不替大家辩护。

source: If you’re the professional you say you are, then surely you can tell the difference between what you’ve said and what matters.
translation: 如果你真像自己所说的那样专业，就一定能分清你说的那些事与真正重要的事。

source: O-Of course I can! My only intent was—
translation: 我、我当然能！我的本意只是——

source: I’ve heard enough.
translation: 我已经听够了。

source: I think we can all agree that each department has had its own communication issues that can be improved upon.
translation: 我想大家都同意，每个部门都有可以改善的沟通问题。

source: However, Ms. Komarova. It’s apparent to me that you’ve been failing to empathize with your co-workers, and it has led to high levels of tension in the project.
translation: 然而，Komarova女士。很明显，你一直没能体谅同事，这导致项目内部高度紧张。

source: May I remind you that as the inspector and as a representative of Clermont Inc., that while your job is to critique and point out flaws, you should do so in a more supportive manner.
translation: 我要提醒你，作为检查员和Clermont公司代表，你的职责虽是批评并指出缺陷，但应当以更具支持性的方式进行。

source: As you’ve noted many times, the deadline is tight, and motivation is a key factor to ensuring completion.
translation: 正如你多次指出的，期限紧迫，而积极性是确保完成项目的关键因素。

source: I am disappointed to be explaining all of this, as I thought a former alumnus would’ve understood these aspects better.
translation: 我很失望还需要解释这些，因为我原以为一位老营员会更理解这些方面。

source: Mr. Clermont, please allow me to explain—
translation: Clermont先生，请允许我解释——

source: You’ve already explained plenty. Frankly, I am even considering that it may be in everyone’s best interest to reassign your position.
translation: 你已经解释得够多了。坦白说，我甚至在考虑，为所有人着想，是否应该把你调任到别的职位。

source: If I may, sir…
translation: 容我说一句，先生……

source: Outside of these issues, Emilia has done her job to the best of her abilities.
translation: 除了这些问题，Emilia已经尽其所能完成了工作。

source: If you would allow us to fix the communication problems brought up, I’m sure we can still work this out.
translation: 如果您允许我们解决刚才提到的沟通问题，我相信事情仍能处理好。

source: Very well. I’m glad that you’re willing to resolve this amongst yourselves.
translation: 很好。很高兴你们愿意自行解决。

source: Regardless, knowing that everything is on track, it’s clear to me that you all have done an excellent job with the project so far.
translation: 不管怎样，既然一切仍按计划进行，很明显各位目前在项目中都做得非常出色。

source: Moving forward, I’m sure everyone here is well aware that we will be pausing this coming winter season.
translation: 接下来，相信在场各位都清楚，我们将在即将到来的冬季暂停施工。

source: We’re going to wait for the weather to pass to avoid any dangerous conditions that could harm the workers.
translation: 我们会等待恶劣天气过去，避免任何可能伤害工人的危险环境。

source: Originally, we planned to jump straight into administrative tasks and other integrations that could be done indoors.
translation: 原本我们计划直接转入可在室内完成的行政任务和其他整合工作。

source: But, after reviewing the project’s progress over the last two months, I’ve decided that it’s in everyone’s best interest to take a few days off and let loose with a well-deserved break.
translation: 不过在审查过去两个月的项目进展后，我决定让大家休息几天，享受一次应得的放松，这对所有人都最好。

source: With that being said, I took it upon myself to arrange a little getaway for the entire team!
translation: 因此，我亲自为整个团队安排了一次短途度假！

source: Getaway…?
translation: 度假……？

source: I've been so impressed with how hard you've all worked, so I thought it would be fitting to set up a celebratory trip! I booked an exclusive hotel for everyone to stay at this weekend!
translation: 大家的辛勤工作给我留下了深刻印象，所以我认为安排一次庆祝旅行很合适！我为所有人预订了一家专属酒店，这周末入住！

source: A-Are you sure, Mr. Clermont? Your sponsorship has already done so much for us, I’m not sure if we should accept—
translation: 您、您确定吗，Clermont先生？您的赞助已经为我们做了这么多，我不确定是否应该接受——

source: Well, I believe it’s important to unwind, especially after several months of hard work.
translation: 我认为放松很重要，尤其在辛苦工作了几个月之后。

source: Besides, I think it would be a great opportunity to teambuild and improve personal relationships, don’t you think?
translation: 而且我认为这是团队建设、改善人际关系的绝佳机会，你不这么觉得吗？

source: Please use this trip as a chance to further get to know one another so that you can properly empathize with each other once work resumes.
translation: 请利用这次旅行进一步了解彼此，这样恢复工作后才能真正互相体谅。

source: Of course, sir... If that’s the case, we’ll do our best to meet your expectations.
translation: 当然，先生……既然如此，我们会尽力达到您的期望。

source: Thank you very much for your generosity.
translation: 非常感谢您的慷慨。

source: Great! With that being said, I can schedule a shuttle to pick everyone up as early as tomorrow from Camp Buddy!
translation: 很好！那么我可以安排接驳车，最早明天就从伙伴营接各位出发！

source: You have the entire night to prepare and pack up for your wonderful vacation!
translation: 你们有整晚时间准备行李，迎接这场美妙假期！

source: If there are no more questions, then this meeting is adjourned.
translation: 如果没有其他问题，会议到此结束。

source: Thank you again, Mr. Clermont. We’ll take our leave then.
translation: 再次感谢您，Clermont先生。那我们先告辞了。

source: Ah…! Please excuse me!
translation: 啊……！请容我失陪！

source: Emilia, wait! Can we please talk?
translation: Emilia，等等！我们能谈谈吗？

source: What?!
translation: 什么？！

source: What’s your problem?! You’ve been acting this way for months now!
translation: 你到底有什么问题？！这几个月你一直是这种态度！

source: Seriously?! After everyone tore into me back there, you still have the nerve to attack me like this?!
translation: 认真的吗？！刚才所有人都把我批得体无完肤，你居然还有脸这样攻击我？！

source: I’m just trying to understand you!
translation: 我只是想理解你！

source: Understand me?! I tried to get back in touch with you from the start, and you never once reciprocated!
translation: 理解我？！从一开始我就努力想和你重新联系，可你从来没有回应过一次！

source: Here I was trying my hardest to help you and this stupid camp, but you didn’t think twice about humiliating me in front of everyone!
translation: 我在这里竭尽全力帮助你和这座愚蠢的营地，可你却毫不犹豫地当众羞辱我！

source: That’s not true, Emilia! I was only trying to reason with you!
translation: 不是那样，Emilia！我只是想和你讲道理！

source: We both know how hard everyone worked to reach our goals, but you still pointed out so many unnecessary things!
translation: 我们都知道大家为实现目标付出了多少努力，可你还是指出那么多没必要的事情！

source: Can’t you just admit that you’re making a problem when there isn’t one?!
translation: 你就不能承认自己是在没问题的地方制造问题吗？！

source: I’m just doing my job! It’s not my fault that none of you can accept how wrong you all are!
translation: 我只是在做自己的工作！你们都无法接受自己错得有多离谱，又不是我的错！

source: You can’t expect me to just stand there while you berate everyone, especially Aiden!
translation: 你痛骂所有人，尤其是Aiden时，不能指望我只是站在旁边！

source: Don’t think I haven’t noticed how much you’ve been belittling him since you first got here!
translation: 别以为我没注意到，从你刚来这里起就一直在贬低他！

source: He’s taken it all in stride, and even been nice to you the entire time, but you still won’t let up!
translation: 他一直从容接受，甚至始终对你很友善，可你还是不肯罢休！

source: Aiden again?! All you ever talk about is him!
translation: 又是Aiden？！你开口闭口都是他！

source: You know what, I’m done with you, Yoshinori.
translation: 知道吗，我受够你了，Yoshinori。

source: And I thought you were my friend...
translation: 我还以为你是我的朋友……

source: You’ve changed.
translation: 你变了。

source: {i}After all this time, I guess the tension and stress of dealing with Emilia finally exploded out of me…{/i}
translation: {i}这么久以来，应付Emilia积累的紧张与压力终于从我心中爆发了……{/i}

source: {i}I do feel bad that I upset her as much as I did, but I couldn’t keep doing nothing.{/i}
translation: {i}让她如此难过，我确实感到愧疚，但不能继续什么都不做。{/i}

source: {i}It’s a good thing Mr. Clermont was so generous to offer us a trip to bond together… Maybe we can help resolve our issues there.{/i}
translation: {i}幸好Clermont先生慷慨地为我们安排了增进感情的旅行……也许能在那里解决彼此的问题。{/i}

source: {i}And after all those months of hard work, I think everyone could use a break.{/i}
translation: {i}而且辛苦工作了这么多个月，我想每个人都需要休息。{/i}

source: {i}Eventually we drove back to Camp Buddy and all began to pack for the trip.{/i}
translation: {i}最后我们开车回到伙伴营，所有人都开始为旅行收拾行李。{/i}

source: Yikes… She really said all that?
translation: 天啊……她真的说了那些话？

source: Yeah… I think I may have upset her even more than when we were with Mr. Clermont.
translation: 是啊……我想自己让她比和Clermont先生在一起时更加生气了。

source: I dunno, Yoshi… Maybe you hanging out with me so much is starting to cause a problem.
translation: 我不知道，Yoshi……也许你总和我待在一起，已经开始造成问题了。

source: Don’t you think it’d be easier for you to let me handle my work on my own?
translation: 让我独自处理工作，对你来说不是更轻松吗？

source: We don’t have to do that, Aiden.
translation: 我们不必这么做，Aiden。

source: After working with you these past few months, I really got to see just how much stuff you have on your plate.
translation: 过去几个月与你一起工作后，我真正看到了你肩上承担了多少事情。

source: It’s really not something one person can do. So please let me help you.
translation: 那真的不是一个人能完成的。所以请让我帮助你。

source: Ehh… If you’re sure…
translation: 呃……既然你确定……

source: Yeah! Don’t sweat it, Aiden!
translation: 是啊！别担心，Aiden！

source: Gah! These suitcases sure are heavy!
translation: 啊！这些行李箱真重！

source: I told you to let me carry them for you…
translation: 我叫你让我替你拿……

source: Th-Thanks for carrying mine though, Sir Goro…
translation: 不、不过谢谢您替我拿行李，Goro先生……

source: No problem.
translation: 没问题。

source: Whoa… You guys are already packed?
translation: 哇……你们已经收拾好了？

source: Heck yeah! You guys don’t even know how excited I am for this trip! It’s been so long since I went on a vacation!
translation: 当然！你们根本不知道我有多期待这次旅行！我已经很久没度假了！

source: The last time was at a beach.
translation: 上次是在海滩。

source: Oh, we actually went to a beach too with the scouts not too long ago!
translation: 哦，我们不久前也和童子军一起去了海滩！

source: Yeah, but that was like a work trip! This time we won’t have any responsibilities… and that’s basically never happened before!
translation: 是啊，但那更像出差！这次我们没有任何责任……这种事以前几乎从没发生过！

source: That’s exactly why I agreed to Mr. Clermont’s offer. We couldn’t pass up the chance to bond like this.
translation: 这正是我接受Clermont先生提议的原因。不能错过这样增进感情的机会。

source: I-I’ll be honest, the only outdoor vacation I’ve ever been on was at this camp…
translation: 老、老实说，我唯一经历过的户外度假就是在这座营地……

source: We’re booked at a hotel, though, so I’m sure it’ll be like a staycation at least. You’ll be comfortable with that, right?
translation: 不过我们订的是酒店，所以至少会像宅度假一样。你会适应的，对吧？

source: Y-Yeah, I guess…
translation: 是、是啊，我想会的……

source: Don’t worry Jin, I’m in the same boat as you! I’ve never been on a trip like this before.
translation: 别担心，Jin，我和你一样！我从没参加过这样的旅行。

source: We’ll both be like headless chickens, haha!
translation: 我们两个都会像无头苍蝇一样，哈哈！

source: HNGHHHH…!!!
translation: 嗯啊啊啊……！！！

source: O-Oh…! Let me help you with that suitcase, Yuri!
translation: 哦、哦……！让我帮你拿那个行李箱，Yuri！

source: GAH!!
Whoa… What’s up with all the luggage, Yuri?
translation: 哇……怎么这么多行李，Yuri？

source: This is for me and Dad! I always pack for him during trips like this or he’ll forget something!
translation: 这些是我和爸爸的！这种旅行我总要替他收拾，不然他会忘带东西！

source: *ehem* It’s not that I forget things, it’s more that I only bring what I need.
translation: *咳咳* 我不是忘记东西，只是只带自己需要的。

source: Oh yeah? Remember when we went to the beach last summer and you kept asking me for your razor?
translation: 是吗？还记得去年夏天去海滩时，你一直问我要剃须刀吗？

source: You were so cranky you didn’t get to shave that morning, especially before you got your coffee!
translation: 那天早上没能刮胡子，你脾气坏透了，尤其是喝咖啡之前！

source: *sigh* Did you really have to share that with everyone, Yuri?
translation: *叹气* 你真的非得把这件事告诉所有人吗，Yuri？

source: And besides, we don’t need to pack as many essential things. Usually hotels provide them, don’t they?
translation: 而且我们不必带那么多生活必需品。酒店通常都会提供，不是吗？

source: Better to be safe than sorry!
translation: 有备无患总比后悔好！

source: It makes me wonder what kind of hotel it is. Mr. Clermont didn’t really give us any details.
translation: 这让我好奇那会是怎样的酒店。Clermont先生并没有透露什么细节。

source: Yeah. What are we supposed to pack even?
translation: 是啊。我们到底该带些什么？

source: Well, I’d make sure and pack some cold weather clothes! It’s getting a lot chillier lately and winter’s coming really soon!
translation: 这个嘛，我会确保带上御寒衣物！最近越来越冷，冬天很快就到了！

source: I just hope there’s a wi-fi connection there… that’s all I need to survive.
translation: 我只希望那里有无线网络……这是我生存所需的一切。

source: Where’s your sense of camaraderie, Jin? There’s no better connection than the connection through real life experiences with your friends, am I right?
translation: 你的伙伴情谊去哪了，Jin？没有什么连接比和朋友共同经历现实生活更好，对吧？

source: Cringe.
translation: 真尴尬。

source: Hey, I’m being serious!
translation: 喂，我是认真的！

source: Of course, Mr. ‘Sirius’!
translation: 当然了，“Sirius”先生！

source: EYY!
translation: 嘿！

source: EYYY!!
*facepalms*
translation: *捂脸*

source: I guess I’m just not used to having friends to hang out with… But I promise I’ll try not to spend the whole trip on my phone or computer!
translation: 我想自己只是不习惯有朋友一起玩……但我保证尽量不会整趟旅行都盯着手机或电脑！

source: I’m just glad I don’t have to hear Emilia boss us around for at least a couple of days.
translation: 至少有几天不用听Emilia对我们发号施令，我就很高兴了。

source: You guys have no idea how much just her voice has been irritating me for the last few months!
translation: 你们根本不知道，过去几个月光是她的声音就让我有多烦！

source: Trust us, dear. We know.
translation: 相信我们，亲爱的。我们知道。

source: But can you at least try to get along with her like Mr. Clermont asked?
translation: 不过你至少能不能像Clermont先生要求的那样，试着和她相处？

source: It’s not even about getting along. She’s just a flat-out bitch!
translation: 这根本不是能否相处的问题。她就是个彻头彻尾的贱人！

source: Now calm down, Yuri. Like Mr. Clermont said, this trip might be a good chance for us to unwind after all the stress from work.
translation: 冷静点，Yuri。就像Clermont先生说的，这次旅行或许是我们摆脱工作压力、放松身心的好机会。

source: I’m just relieved you said something back there, Yoshi.
translation: 我只是很庆幸你刚才站出来说话，Yoshi。

source: Oh yeah! That was so satisfying! In my head I was like “Yesss! Yesss! Get her, Yoshi!”
translation: 哦，没错！太痛快了！我心里一直在喊：“对！就是这样！反击她，Yoshi！”

source: Ms. Emilia is so scary… I thought she’d be a lot less aggressive in front of Mr. Clermont, but she didn’t even think twice about calling each of us out like that…
translation: Emilia女士太可怕了……我以为她在Clermont先生面前会收敛许多，可她还是毫不犹豫地那样逐个批评我们……

source: She’s so business-minded she couldn’t care less about our feelings! I bet that was the ugly side of a Capricorn talking!
translation: 她满脑子都是公事，根本不在乎我们的感受！我敢说那是摩羯座丑陋的一面在说话！

source: But that explosive attitude sounds like something an Aries would do – they can be control freaks too.
translation: 不过那种火爆态度更像白羊座——他们也可能是控制狂。

source: She’s neither. She’s just mean.
translation: 她哪个都不是。她只是刻薄。

source: I was honestly about to say something, but I’m glad Yoshinori stepped in before I did. If I had, I would’ve been much more blunt with her.
translation: 老实说，我正准备开口，不过幸好Yoshinori先站了出来。换成我，肯定会说得直接得多。

source: I-I was actually thinking about it on our way home… As embarrassing as it was to argue with Emilia in front of Mr. Clermont, I had to do it because…
translation: 其、其实回来的路上我一直在想……虽然当着Clermont先生的面和Emilia争吵很难堪，但我必须那么做，因为……

source: I-I was actually thinking about it on our way home… As embarrassing as it was to argue with Emilia in front of Mr. Clermont, I had to do it because…{fast}
translation: 其、其实回来的路上我一直在想……虽然当着Clermont先生的面和Emilia争吵很难堪，但我必须那么做，因为……{fast}

source: It wasn't a productive conversation.
translation: 那已经不是有建设性的谈话了。

source: It wasn’t a productive conversation anymore.
translation: 那已经不再是有建设性的谈话了。

source: Ugh! I know right?!
translation: 呃！可不是吗？！

source: She was trying to discredit everyone.
translation: 她试图否定所有人的功劳。

source: She was trying to discredit all of us after our hard work.
translation: 大家辛苦工作后，她却试图否定我们所有人的功劳。

source: She was saying hurtful things.
translation: 她说了很多伤人的话。

source: She was saying so many hurtful things, especially about Aiden.
translation: 她说了太多伤人的话，尤其是针对Aiden。

source: Ugh! I know right?! I didn’t mind when she was talking shit about me! But why did she have to pick on Aiden for some reason?!
translation: 呃！就是啊？！她说我的坏话我不在乎！可她为什么偏偏要针对Aiden？！

source: Don’t worry about me, you guys…! I swear I’m fine!
translation: 别担心我，各位……！我发誓自己没事！

source: She was so disrespectful.
translation: 她太不尊重人了。

source: She was being so disrespectful, especially to Aiden.
translation: 她太不尊重人了，尤其是对Aiden。

source: I’m already at my wits end with that girl. I don’t think we’ll ever be friends outside of work.
translation: 我已经被那个女人逼到忍耐极限了。我觉得工作之外我们永远不可能成为朋友。

source: We don’t have to be friends with Emilia, but we don’t have to antagonize her either.
translation: 我们不必和Emilia做朋友，但也不必与她敌对。

source: We just have to learn to not take her personal remarks seriously and focus on our jobs.
translation: 只要学会不把她的个人评论当回事，专注自己的工作。

source: But if she crosses the line like that again, I’m not going to hold myself back anymore!
translation: 但她要是再那样越界，我绝不会继续忍耐！

source: All this negative energy is exactly why we need to go on a vacation detox.
translation: 正因为这些负面能量，我们才需要用假期好好排毒。

source: Vacay.
translation: 度假。

source: Exactly. This is our chance to spend time with each other and loosen up.
translation: 没错。这是我们彼此相处、放松下来的机会。

source: I like where this is going~
translation: 我喜欢这个发展方向～

source: Not again with the ‘loose’ jokes, Aiden… Let’s just pack.
translation: 别再拿“放松”开荤段子了，Aiden……我们还是收拾行李吧。

source: Did you just say ‘fuck’?
translation: 你刚才是不是说了“操”？

source: Now you guys are just stretching it.
translation: 你们现在纯粹是在硬扯。

source: STRETCH?!
And there we go! That should be all our stuff, Aiden!
translation: 好了！我们的东西应该全都收拾好了，Aiden！

source: Thanks for helping me pack, Yoshi!
translation: 谢谢你帮我收拾，Yoshi！

source: No problem!
translation: 没问题！

source: I know this is gonna sound silly, but I can’t wait to sleep! The faster I go to bed, the sooner the trip starts!
translation: 我知道听起来很傻，但我已经等不及睡觉了！越早上床，旅行就越快开始！

source: I get it! I’m just as excited as you are!
translation: 我明白！我和你一样兴奋！

source: I mean… I can’t help it! After being so busy for the last two months, we finally get some time to relax!
translation: 我是说……没办法不兴奋！忙了两个月后，我们终于有时间放松！

source: I know we’ve been spending a lot more time together lately, but this time around it’s a hundred percent quality time! No doing laundry or washing dishes, hahaha!
translation: 我知道最近我们相处的时间多了很多，但这次百分之百都是珍贵时光！不用洗衣服，也不用洗盘子，哈哈哈！

source: Yeah! Let’s make sure we have a great time on this vacation!
translation: 是啊！我们一定要在假期玩个痛快！

source: Hm? Is that…?
translation: 嗯？那是……？

source: No use trying to hide under that blanket, Jin. We can hear you on your computer~!
translation: 躲在毯子下面也没用，Jin。我们听得到你在用电脑～！

source: A-Ah…! I’m sorry, was my keyboard too loud?
translation: 啊、啊……！抱歉，是键盘声音太大了吗？

source: *sigh* You know he’s working, Aiden…
translation: *叹气* 你知道他在工作，Aiden……

source: O-Oh…! I’m not working either!
translation: 哦、哦……！我也没有在工作！

source: Although, I guess technically you could say that I’m working on something…
translation: 不过严格来说，也可以说我在做某件事……

source: It’s that side thing we started, Yoshi. I never had the time to get back to it since we’ve been so busy lately.
translation: 就是我们开始的那个副项目，Yoshi。最近太忙，我一直没时间继续。

source: Wait, what…? No, Aiden!
translation: 等等，什么……？不是，Aiden！

source: *cough* I wish it was.
translation: *咳嗽* 我倒希望是。

source: Jin and I have this little website project where we’re transcribing Yuri’s journal and restoring the photos for a blog!
translation: Jin 和我有个小型网站项目，要把Yuri的日记整理成文字、修复照片，再做成博客！

source: You lost me at website…
translation: 说到网站我就听不懂了……

source: Ahehe… I didn’t really understand all the tech stuff at first either, but Jin here has been teaching me a lot!
translation: 啊嘿嘿……一开始我也不懂那些技术内容，不过 Jin 教了我很多！

source: Oh, if you’re not too tired, Aiden, why don’t we help Jin finish up tonight?
translation: 哦，如果你不太累，Aiden，我们今晚何不帮 Jin 完成？

source: Oho~ Don’t mind if I do~
translation: 哦嚯～我当然不介意～

source: Come on! Let’s get on his bunk and work on tonight’s entry!
translation: 来吧！我们上他的床铺，一起处理今晚的条目！

source: W-Wah! Is it finally happening?!
translation: 哇、哇！终于要发生了吗？！

source: Whew! Finally, it’s done!
translation: 呼！终于完成了！

source: Thanks for helping me set up the tent, Aiden! Couldn’t have done it without you!
translation: 谢谢你帮我搭帐篷，Aiden！没有你我做不到！

source: You’re welcome, Yoshi!
translation: 不客气，Yoshi！

source: Hehe, you guys sure had a long day today, huh?
translation: 嘿嘿，你们今天真是漫长的一天，对吧？

source: Yeaaahhh… I thought my legs were gonna break off from that ten-mile hike!
translation: 是——啊……那场十英里徒步让我以为双腿都要断了！

source: Not to mention we had that foraging activity! All I could gather were mushrooms and herbs… And that’s supposed to be our dinner too…
translation: 更别提还有采集活动！我只找到蘑菇和香草……而且那还要当我们的晚餐……

source: Don’t worry, Yoshi! We brought meat!
translation: 别担心，Yoshi！我们带了肉！

source: I’m sure Dad can make something really tasty out of what you guys gathered!
translation: 我相信爸爸能用你们采到的东西做出真正美味的食物！

source: He’s gonna let me help cook today too, so it’s gonna be extra special!
translation: 他今天也会让我帮忙做饭，所以会格外特别！

source: Wow!! I can’t wait! I can always count on you and your dad to cook up something good!
translation: 哇！！我等不及了！你和你爸爸总能做出好吃的！

source: I gotta say though, you guys were pretty busy yourselves today too.
translation: 不过我得说，你们今天也相当忙碌。

source: You had to hike, and then prepare everyone’s meals on top of that…
translation: 你们既要徒步，还要为所有人准备餐点……

source: It’s alright! It’s my job to help after all!
translation: 没关系！毕竟帮助大家就是我的工作！

source: Now I feel bad that I get to do all these activities while all you do is work…
translation: 现在我有点内疚，我能参加这些活动，而你却一直在工作……

source: I gotta ask the scoutmasters to let you join for the next one!
translation: 下次我得请教官们让你也参加！

source: Ehhh… You don’t have to do that, Yoshi!
translation: 呃……你不用这样，Yoshi！

source: Don’t worry, I can just sneak you in!
translation: 别担心，我可以把你偷偷带进去！

source: *sigh* Yoshi… You’ve already done so much for me.
translation: *叹气* Yoshi……你已经为我做了很多。

source: I’m already happy enough getting to spend time with you, you know?
translation: 能和你共度时光，我已经足够开心了，明白吗？

source: Aww, that’s so sweet, Aiden! This is why you’re my best friend!
translation: 啊，真贴心，Aiden！所以你才是我最好的朋友！

source: Hehe.
translation: 嘿嘿。

source: Fwah! It feels so nice to rest my legs after all that walking!
translation: 呼啊！走了那么久，现在让双腿休息真舒服！

source: Aren’t you gonna lie down? You must be pretty tired too!
translation: 你不躺下吗？你肯定也很累！

source: Yeah, I guess I kinda am.
translation: 是啊，我想确实有点累。

source: Here, there’s plenty of space for both of us!
translation: 来，这里有足够我们两个人躺的空间！

source: Whew… You’re right.  Now that I’m laying down, I can’t feel my legs anymore, haha!
translation: 呼……你说得对。现在一躺下，我已经感觉不到双腿了，哈哈！

source: Oh, I just got an idea! You should move into our cabin from now on!
translation: 哦，我刚想到一个主意！从现在起你应该搬进我们的小屋！

source: Y-You mean sleep together with you and all the scouts? I don’t think I’m allowed to…
translation: 你、你是说和你以及所有童子军睡在一起？我觉得自己不被允许……

source: It doesn’t say anywhere in the camp rules that you can’t! So, you have no excuses, hahaha!
translation: 营地规则里没有任何地方说你不可以！所以你没有借口，哈哈哈！

source: Well… I’d really like that. I know Dad wouldn’t mind.
translation: 这个嘛……我真的很愿意。我知道爸爸不会介意。

source: Consider it done then! Yuri and I can arrange that with the president! *wink*
translation: 那就这么定了！我和Yuri可以向负责人安排！*眨眼*

source: Sheesh… I dunno what to say, Yoshi.
translation: 天啊……我不知道该说什么，Yoshi。

source: Say, yes?
translation: 说“好”？

source: Hehe, alright, you got me.
translation: 嘿嘿，好吧，被你说服了。

source: Score! I just got the best roommate!
translation: 太棒了！我得到了最好的室友！

source: Thanks, Yoshi…
translation: 谢谢，Yoshi……

source: Hehe, don’t say thanks yet until you’re fully moved in.
translation: 嘿嘿，等你彻底搬进来再道谢。

source: Alright…
translation: 好吧……

source: *yawn* Now I’m feeling kinda sleepy…
translation: *打哈欠* 现在我有点困了……

source: This is nice…
translation: 这样真好……

source: KYAAAAA!!!!
translation: 呀啊啊啊！！！！

source: So that’s where you two were!
translation: 原来你们两个在这里！

source: Gosh, Yuri...! You scared me!
translation: 天啊，Yuri……！你吓到我了！

source: AM I SEEING WHAT I THINK I’M SEEING?!
translation: 我看到的是自己以为的那一幕吗？！

source: Two boys cuddling in a tent, zero feet apart ’cause they’re very much gay~
translation: 两个男孩在帐篷里依偎，距离为零，因为他们真的非常基～

source: Eh? What’s going on?
translation: 咦？发生什么了？

source: *sigh* It’s just another one of Yuri’s episodes…
translation: *叹气* 只是Yuri又一次发作……

source: With Yoshi’s arms lovingly entwined around Aiden’s slim yet chiseled body, they share each other’s heat…
translation: Yoshi满怀爱意地用手臂环住Aiden纤瘦而结实的身体，两人分享着彼此的热度……

source: Y-Yuri…!!
translation: 尤、Yuri……！！

source: Hahaha!
translation: 哈哈哈！

source: Aiden, it’s time to make di—
translation: Aiden，该做晚——

source: WAH! Mr. Andre, it’s not what you think…!!
translation: 哇！Andre先生，不是您想的那样……！！

source: The shocking turn of events reveals the forbidden affair!
translation: 惊人的转折揭开了禁忌恋情！

source: Eh? I’m not sure I understand…
translation: 咦？我不太明白……

source: Oh, hey Dad! It’s probably time to cook dinner, right?
translation: 哦，嘿，爸爸！差不多该做晚饭了，对吧？

source: Yep! Now if you both don’t mind, I’ll be taking my little chef to work!
translation: 没错！如果两位不介意，我要带我的小厨师去工作了！

source: Seeya later, you two!
translation: 回头见，你们两个！

source: Alas… The threads of fate have snapped, and only time will tell if destiny shall bring them back together again…
translation: 唉……命运之线已经断裂，只有时间能证明宿命是否会让他们再次相聚……

source: *sigh* Yuri…
translation: *叹气* Yuri……

source: Alright, this entry is done, but I can’t believe it’s already past midnight!
translation: 好了，这个条目完成了，可真不敢相信已经过了午夜！

source: We didn’t even notice how long we were working on this. I can see how you struggle with the concept of time, Jin!
translation: 我们完全没注意到做了多久。现在我明白你为什么总是没有时间概念了，Jin！

source: Look who you’re talking to.
translation: 先看看你在和谁说话。

source: Ahehe… This is the first time I’ve seen him asleep at night.
translation: 啊嘿嘿……这是我第一次看见他晚上睡觉。

source: Let me just tuck him in, then let’s get off his bunk.
translation: 让我替他盖好被子，然后我们从他的床铺下去。

source: Aww, isn’t that cute? You sound just like my dad right now, Yoshi~!
translation: 啊，真可爱，不是吗？你现在听起来就像我爸爸，Yoshi～！

source: You better not start calling me Gramps too.
translation: 你最好别也开始叫我Gramps。

source: Everybody else is already asleep, should we join them?
translation: 其他人都已经睡了，我们也睡吧？

source: Yup!
translation: 好！

source: Good night, Aiden!
translation: 晚安，Aiden！

source: Good night, Yoshi~
translation: 晚安，Yoshi～
